task_goal: work out which pans survive a new induction hob and what has to be replaced before it is fitted
tail_anchor: The old hob goes out on Tuesday.
notes: rep_unres and rep_res differ only by 'it' vs 'the Christmas non-stick' with two equally flawed pans live; norep_unres and norep_res differ by one word, ten vs fourteen centimetres, against a stated twelve-centimetre minimum.

evidence_spans.quote: the old black steel one from my mother, which rocks a bit on a flat surface, and the non-stick one we bought at Christmas

Neither is a clean yes. The black steel one would grip, but induction wants a flat base and yours rocks. The Christmas non-stick is aluminium with a thin steel disc, so it will heat, but those disc bases hot-spot badly.
evidence_spans.role: both candidates re-activated and neither ruled out

evidence_spans.quote: I'll take it down the tip then and buy a replacement.
